definitions.explanation: A flat piece of copper metal, used in construction, art, and crafts.

⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{銅板|どうばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Copper plates are often used for shrine roofs.

examples.english: A copper plate roof exposed to years of wind and rain turns a beautiful verdigris green, creating a distinctive elegance.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：19443_dou⟧ (copper) and {板|ばん} (plate, board). Copper plates are widely used in traditional Japanese architecture, especially for roofing shrines and temples. Over time, copper develops a characteristic green patina ({緑青|ろくしょう}) that is considered beautiful and is a hallmark of aged Japanese architecture.

{銅板|どうばん} is also used in metalworking and printmaking ({銅版画|どうはんが}, copperplate engraving).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {銅板|どうばん}{葺|ぶ}き: copper-plate roofing
- {銅板|どうばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧: copper roof
- {銅板|どうばん}⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: copper plate processing
- {銅板|どうばん}レリーフ: copper plate relief

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鉄板|てっぱん}→鉄板：14470_teppan⟧: iron plate; steel plate — thicker and heavier, used for cooking and construction
- {銅版画|どうはんが}: copperplate engraving — a printmaking technique using etched copper plates
- {金属板|きんぞくばん}: metal plate — the general term for any metal sheet
